name: Changes in smoking status affect clozapine exposure
actions: Record current tobacco smoking and any recent change in smoking status.
Monitor clozapine response and adverse effects when smoking starts or stops; consider dosage reassessment after cessation.

rationale: Tobacco smoke is a moderate CYP1A2 inducer and can lower clozapine concentrations.
Discontinuing smoking can raise clozapine concentrations and adverse effect risk.

explanation_template: Tobacco smoke induces CYP1A2 and can lower clozapine exposure. Stopping smoking can raise clozapine levels, so changes in smoking status require review.

references.citation: Tobacco smoke is a moderate CYP1A2 inducer; clozapine dosage may need reassessment when induction stops.
